2024-06-27 Goffertpark, Nijmegen, The Netherlands

Share: 

Scheduled: 18:00 Local Start Time 19:45 / End Time 22:33

Info & Setlist | Venue

30-song setlist includes "Sherry Darling" and the final tour performances of "Cover Me" and "Cadillac Ranch", the latter in its sole 2024 appearance. Opening act is Benny Sings.
